criteria.criterion: Investigate owner-reported ChatGPT card showing Choose a station without Countries/NTS tabs; distinguish current resource delivery, iframe sizing, stale connection metadata and actual observed host evidence.
criteria.evidence: The owner reported “Couldn’t open Find radio stations by country.” Triage records a public resources/read of historical `ui://dial/country-v9.html` returning JSON-RPC -32602 not found before the fix, while canonical v13 returned current Countries/NTS HTML and current CSP. Historical v9 markup matches the pasted old summary/no-tabs UI; current source/tool metadata points to v13, while the connected tool description was also observed stale. This distinguishes server/resource delivery and metadata from iframe sizing: no host screenshot/dimensions were observed. The exact URI request by the owner card and causal link to the error remain inference, not direct host evidence.
criteria.method: Compared the owner-reported message and supplied old-card text with Foreman/Triage public SDK records, historical URI evidence, current server source, and candidate local SDK tests. Checked what was and was not directly observable.

criteria.criterion: Reproduce and fix any verified presentation or entry-point defect without changing approved station/playback/network policy; give a direct verifiable path to the existing NTS UI if needed.
criteria.evidence: Full suite: 40 passed, 0 failed; focused SDK resource integration: 1 passed, 0 failed. Local SDK reads v1 through v12, each with response URI equal to the requested alias, MIME equal to canonical, byte-identical current HTML, identical current CSP, Countries/NTS controls and fixed NTS URL. Unknown v99 is rejected. Current discovery tools still reference canonical v13. The verified old v9 missing-resource condition is therefore covered by a finite current-renderer alias; no legacy UI or station/playback/network policy was restored. No public server was restarted.
criteria.method: Ran `npm test` and focused `node --test test/server.test.js` against the exact candidate. Inspected alias registration and the public SDK integration assertions.
